column2: DialogueText

Welcome to Baishan!
You must try our local cuisine.
If you're looking to stock up on supplies I might be able to give you some guidance.

The general store is located to the west side of the main plaza.
There you can purchase armor, food and other supplies.
You came here looking for strong fighters to join you and prevent the kingdom falling into chaos?

I spent my entire life in this town perfecting my martial arts...
But never had the chance to use my powers to help others..
Let me join you on your adventures!

I heard of a strong fighter living in this town...
If I can convince her to join my cause I might be able to prevent the calamity...

Stop right there!
You'll need to leave behind your weapons if you want to enter Baishan.
You can get your belongings back upon departure.

I can tell that you're not from around here.
We don't often get visitors from other regions of the kingdom.
Subscribe to Cobra Code for more on Unreal 2D!
Hey Sheepherder! The sheep have gotten out of their pen!
Come down here and get them back in their pen!
Don't forget to close the gate when you're done!
You haven't gotten all the sheep in the pen!
Make sure you close the gate once they're inside!
Good job, you got them all back in their pen!
Meet me back up at the house,
I've got something to give to you.

This is my heron-marked blade.
You may need it in the times to come...
Please handle it with care.
Trollocs are attacking, protect the sheep!
Don't worry about me, protect the sheep!
I can't help you, I gave you my sword!
We have no chance against that thing!
Our only chance is to run!
I can't believe you beat that thing!
